description_json.name: VowelConsonantInterleaveCipher
description_json.idea: To ensure perfect implementation correctness and high model readability, this cipher uses a simple, deterministic character-swap rule. It swaps adjacent pairs of characters (index 0 with 1, index 2 with 3, etc.) within each word. If a word has an odd number of letters, the last letter remains in its position. Non-letter characters, spaces, and punctuation are not swapped and remain in their original positions, acting as boundaries.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Split the text into words using spaces and punctuation as boundaries.
2. For each word, swap adjacent letters: swap the 1st and 2nd letter, the 3rd and 4th letter, and so on.
3. If a word has an odd number of letters, the last letter is left unchanged.
4. All non-letter characters (spaces, punctuation, numbers) remain in their exact original positions.

3. If a word has an odd number of letters, the last letter is left unchanged.
4. All non-letter characters (spaces, punctuation, numbers) remain in their exact original positions.
